name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 2 Intermediate — Terrorize

system.activation: Summons fully immersive illusions of the victim's worst fears, visible only to her. Bid Mental Traits equal to her Courage Traits and defeat her in a Mental Challenge; if she loses, she must win a Courage Virtue Test against a four-Trait difficulty or spend a Mental Trait to take any action other than cowering, for the rest of the scene.
